name: Crust for Meat Pie
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Sift 1 level teaspoon of soda and 1 teaspoon salt in a pint of flour
Wet with sour milk to a nice batter that will drop from the spoon
Have the meat prepared as for meat pie, with it hot in dish when crust is ready
Take a piece of white paper, make a tube with paper, place in centre of meat dish and spread batter over top of pie

source.originalInstructions:
1. Sift 1 level teaspoon of soda and 1 teaspoon salt in a pint of flour
2. Rub into flour 1 tablespoon lard
3. Wet with sour milk to a nice batter that will drop from the spoon
4. Have the meat prepared as for meat pie, with it hot in dish when crust is ready
5. Take a piece of white paper, make a tube with paper, place in centre of meat dish and spread batter over top of pie
6. Bake 1/2 hour
